local L=game:GetService("Lighting")
local H=game:GetService("HttpService")
if game.Name~="AEGIS_Reactor.rbxlx" then error("Wrong place") end
local old=L:FindFirstChild("ColorGrading")
if not old or not old:IsA("ColorGradingEffect") then error("Edit Lighting ColorGrading missing") end
local prior={style=tostring(L.LightingStyle),priority=L.PrioritizeLightingQuality,
 shadows=L.GlobalShadows,tone=tostring(old.TonemapperPreset)}
local ok,why=pcall(function()
 L.LightingStyle=Enum.LightingStyle.Realistic
 L.PrioritizeLightingQuality=true
 L.GlobalShadows=true
 old.TonemapperPreset=Enum.TonemapperPreset.Default
end)
if not ok then
 pcall(function() L.LightingStyle=Enum.LightingStyle.Soft
 L.PrioritizeLightingQuality=prior.priority;L.GlobalShadows=prior.shadows
 old.TonemapperPreset=Enum.TonemapperPreset.Retro end)
 error("Lighting edit rolled back: "..tostring(why))
end
return H:JSONEncode({success=true,before=prior,after={style=tostring(L.LightingStyle),
 priority=L.PrioritizeLightingQuality,shadows=L.GlobalShadows,
 tone=tostring(old.TonemapperPreset)},note="Edit place changed; save file in Studio later"})
